basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Queensland, Australia. I recently discovered Reddit and have been exploring various communities, learning and sharing experiences. I'm passionate about cooking, especially Southern cuisine, thanks to my grandmother's influence. In my downtime, I enjoy playing 'Lord of the Rings: Rise to War' and tinkering with PC builds. My work hours are flexible, but I usually browse Reddit in the evenings. Currently single, I like to spend weekends trying out new recipes or catching up with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Graphic Design from a local university. I've always been a visual person, and my passion for design comes through both formal education and years of self-teaching through online tutorials and forums. Recently, I've been expanding my knowledge in PC building and exploring different software related to gaming.
